# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-09-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA8-EMA50 ribbon compresses to <0.1% width for 15 minutes, a breakout on above-average volume signals a short-term momentum move. This captures intraday mean-reversion exhaustion followed by a directional impulse that the engine can ride with a chart-stop at the opposite ribbon edge.

## Mechanism

Calculate ribbon width = abs(EMA8 - EMA50)/EMA50 on 5‑min bars. If width < 0.001 for three consecutive bars and volume > 1.3 * average volume of the prior 5 bars, await a close outside the ribbon (above EMA8 for long, below EMA50 for short). Enter at the next bar open in the breakout direction. Exit: chart-stop at the opposite ribbon edge (for long, stop below EMA50; for short, stop above EMA8) or premium‑stop 0.6%; target 1.5R or trail 12% off HWM. Trade only between 11:00‑13:30 ET with VIX 12‑22; avoid first/last 30 minutes and VIX>30.

6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine what % of P&L comes from top‑5 days.
